whatsapp_closure_preferences.description: Most recent explicit closure notice consent per WhatsApp sender scope and verified GLPI requester.
whatsapp_closure_preferences.lifecycle: An employee opts in or withdraws through WhatsApp. Withdrawal clears the delivery address. Re-enabling issues a new grant that cannot revive jobs under the previous grant.

scope_key.description: Stable hash binding the Meta business number and the sender scope.

glpi_user_id.description: Verified GLPI requester who opted in.

grant_id.description: Unique consent epoch bound to eligible ticket watches and queued closure replies.

recipient.description: Validated WhatsApp address for opted-in closure delivery.
recipient.nullMeaning: The employee withdrew the grant and the address was cleared.

granted_at.description: Time at which WhatsApp recorded the active or most recently withdrawn grant.

revoked_at.description: Time at which the employee withdrew the grant.

objects.whatsapp_closure_preferences_pkey: Keeps a single latest grant per sender scope.
objects.whatsapp_closure_preferences_active_reci: Requires a verified positive GLPI ID and limits stored recipients to active grants.
